environment.description: AWS Lambda function running in Step Functions workflow. Lambda execution role has broad permissions (sts:AssumeRole, s3:*, dynamodb:*). IMDSv1 enabled on the Lambda runtime (default). No VPC endpoint policies restricting IMDS access. Lambda is in a public subnet with internet access for outbound HTTP. No permission boundary attached to the Lambda execution role. Step Functions state machine accepts arbitrary webhook_url from API Gateway input without pre-filtering.
